stem.text: The photomicrographs show a cross-section through the lining of part of the respiratory system.

stem.alt: Two photomicrographs: a light micrograph of a tissue section with a small rectangle marked on it, and a larger electron micrograph of the surface of the section joined to the marked area by two lines.

stem.text: Which statements about the photomicrographs are correct?

items: Goblet cells are visible between squamous epithelium cells.
The section cannot be from a bronchiole as cartilage is visible.
